reasoning_content: Der Server startet gut! Es gibt keinen "observedChunks.map" Fehler mehr. Lass mich mehr Log checken um zu sehen ob es komplett startet.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -15 /tmp/server.log")
print("Log:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep 3000")
print("Port:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
